map.Base64 是一种基于 64 个可打印字符来表示二进制数据的编码方式，使用 A: Base64 encodes binary data using 64 printable characters: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, + and / (the URL-safe mode uses - and _). Every 3 bytes become 4 characters, so the data grows by about 33%. It is widely used in email, URLs, and data storage.
map.Base32 使用 A-Z 和 2-7 共 32 个字符，每 5 个字节编码为: Base32 uses the 32 characters A-Z and 2-7. Every 5 bytes become 8 characters, so the data grows by about 60%. Compared with Base64, it is case-insensitive and therefore better suited to case-insensitive systems such as DNS and file names.
map.Base85 使用 85 个 ASCII 字符，每 4 个字节编码为 5 个字符: Base85 uses 85 ASCII characters. Every 4 bytes become 5 characters, so the data grows by only about 25% — the most space-efficient of the common encodings. It is frequently used in formats such as PostScript and PDF.
map.URL安全的 Base64 将 + 替换为 -，/ 替换为 _，并移除末尾的 =: URL-safe Base64 replaces + with - and / with _, and removes the trailing = padding, making the encoded result safe to use in URLs and file names.
